findings.title: From research & innovation to deployment - Publications Office of the EU
findings.finding: EU policy simulations distinguish early product emergence from subsequent industrial capacity and market uptake.
findings.context: The Commission authors apply their RADAR simulation model to technology domains, including semiconductors. Their scenarios show that emergence-focused support has more influence on early products while industrial-scale support becomes important after an upstream base exists. The findings are exploratory model results, not forecasts or observed causal impacts.

findings.title: Living labs as entrepreneurial ecosystem architectures evidence from Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe
findings.authors: Giusy Sica, Chiara Spiniello, Maria Palazzo, Alessandra Micozzi, Giovanna Lusini
findings.finding: Living-lab consortia provide measurable architecture for European multi-actor innovation ecosystems.
findings.context: Researchers construct consortium indicators from CORDIS metadata for 350 projects labelled as living labs. They compare the Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe cohorts on partner diversity, company participation and coordination. Results describe the observed funded-project sample rather than demonstrating programme causality.
